paper.title_en: Regular magnetic black holes with anti-de Sitter cores in scalar-tensor gravity: axial stability and radial instability
paper.abstract_en: We construct static, asymptotically flat regular black holes in Einstein-frame scalar--tensor gravity, sourced by a canonical scalar coupled to magnetic nonlinear electrodynamics. Prescribing the density and scalar profiles, we reconstruct the metric, the scalar--photon coupling and the potential. Regularity requires the mass function to vanish at the centre, which fixes the ADM mass, and the central $r^2$ growth of the density to be compensated by the gradient energy of the scalar. The solutions have an anti-de Sitter core supported by a negative potential and a nearly Reissner--Nordström exterior; absence of ghosts restricts the magnetic charge to an interval that shrinks to zero at a finite core depth. Axial perturbations reduce to a symmetric two-channel master system whose positive-definite potential guarantees mode stability; spectral and time-domain quasinormal frequencies agree. Radial perturbations, by contrast, are unstable: the reconstructed potential behaves as $V\propto-\varphi^5$ near the asymptotic vacuum, the scalar becomes tachyonic outside the horizon, and every ghost-free black hole has a growing monopole mode with $ΓM\approx0.14$--$0.28$. An angular Laplacian instability develops near the centre; for black holes it may lie entirely within the inner horizon, while horizonless solutions leave it uncovered and are therefore excluded.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 该文在标量-张量引力框架下构造了具有反德西特核心的规则磁黑洞，并系统分析了轴向稳定与径向不稳定性，涉及ADM质量、鬼模约束与准正规模谱，理论上较深且方法较为完整，值得深入阅读。
decision.title_zh: 标量-张量引力中具有反德西特核心的规则磁黑洞：轴向稳定性与径向不稳定性
decision.abstract_zh: 我们在爱因斯坦框架的标量-张量引力中构造了静态、渐近平坦的规则黑洞，其源为与磁非线性电动力学耦合的典范标量场。通过给定密度与标量剖面，我们重构了度规、标量-光子耦合以及势函数。规则性要求质量函数在中心处为零，这固定了ADM质量，并且密度的中心$r^2$增长必须由标量的梯度能量补偿。这些解具有由负势支撑的反德西特核心以及近似Reissner--Nordström的外部；无鬼模条件将磁电荷限制在一个区间内，该区间在有限的核心深度处收缩为零。轴向微扰约化为一个对称的双通道主方程系统，其正定势保证了模式稳定性；谱方法与时间域方法得到的准正规模频率一致。相比之下，径向微扰是不稳定的：重构的势在渐近真空附近表现为$V\propto-\varphi^5$，标量在视界外变为快子，并且每个无鬼模黑洞都有一个增长的单极模式，其$ΓM\approx0.14$--$0.28$。在中心附近会出现角拉普拉斯不稳定性；对于黑洞，它可能完全位于内视界之内，而无视界解则无法将其遮蔽，因而被排除。
